description: Complete inventory of all database tables from shared/schema.ts (1449 lines). Each table includes column details, types, constraints, and foreign keys.
source: shared/schema.ts — direct code inspection of Drizzle ORM pgTable definitions

tables.description: Core account information — authentication, identity, and billing stubs
relations: many: userDailyLogs, quests, aiMessages, calendarEvents, missionPages, contacts, spreadsheets
tables.notes: stripe_customer_id and stripe_subscription_id are legacy stubs (Stripe removed). password field stores bcrypt hash. firebase_uid links to Firebase Auth.

tables.description: Player stats, XP, level, streak, efficiency, and system settings
tables.notes: 5 stat token pairs (current/max), all default 100. XP level 1 threshold is 1000. ai_assistant_name defaults to NOVA. System settings mixed into same table.

tables.description: All onboarding answers, character sheet, player record, identity sections, display settings

columns.name: custom_reflection_prompts
columns.default: {"wentWell":"What went well today?","couldBeBetter":"What could have been better?","learned":"What did I learn?"}

tables.notes: Largest table in the schema. Contains deeply personal data across 10+ life sections: identity, personality, vision, learning, projects, health, wealth, performance, style, history, rituals, emotions, and coping. JSONB fields store complex nested data. Contains sensitive data: shadow_distortions, limiting_belief, shadow_patterns, coping_practices, financial_position, trauma-adjacent fields.

tables.description: Daily initialization logs — energy, intentions, reflections, research, data entries
tables.notes: One row per user per day enforced by unique index. Contains 7 log types: energy, intention, data entry, research, reflection, mission log, and stats log.

tables.description: Connected app flags (Apple Health, Google Calendar, Notion)
constraints: fk: user_id -> users.id ON DELETE CASCADE
tables.notes: Flag table only. Apple Health and Notion are flag-only (no actual integration). Google Calendar has real integration via separate integrations table.

tables.description: Missions/tasks — core execution unit with scheduling, repeat patterns, difficulty ranks, vision goal linkage
tables.notes: Most complex table. Supports repeat patterns, ritual groups, vision goal linkage, external sync (Google Tasks), Notion-style custom board views, soft delete. Difficulty ranks: S/A/B/C/D. Default XP reward: 10.

tables.description: Long-term vision goals with time horizons and XP bonuses
tables.notes: Categories: legacy, 10year, 5year, 18month, 90day. Linked to quests via quests.vision_goal_id FK.

tables.description: Legacy AI messages table (pre-conversation model)
tables.notes: Legacy table. Newer conversations/messages tables supersede this for NOVA AI chat.

tables.description: Local and synced calendar events
tables.notes: Unified view: local + Google Calendar synced events. external_id/external_source track Google Calendar items. Categories: work, personal, health.

tables.description: Mission-linked content pages (markdown journal per mission)
Rolodex — personal and professional contacts with relationship metadata
constraints: fk: user_id -> users.id ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.description: User-created spreadsheets stored as JSONB content
constraints: fk: user_id -> users.id ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.description: Visual canvases (shapes, connections, text) stored as JSONB
Knowledge graphs (nodes, edges, styling) stored as JSONB
Nested folder system for document organization (Data Vault)
tables.notes: Supports nested folders via parent_id self-reference. Soft delete via deleted_at. External sync tracking.

tables.description: Markdown documents with external sync support (Google Drive, Obsidian, Evernote)
tables.notes: Supports markdown docs, uploaded files (images, videos, PDFs via file_data base64), and external sync. Soft delete.

tables.description: Document templates for quick creation
constraints: fk: user_id -> users.id ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.description: OAuth tokens and provider connection details (Google, Notion, etc.)
constraints: fk: user_id -> users.id ON DELETE CASCADE
tables.notes: SECURITY CONCERN: access_token and refresh_token are stored as plain text — encryption status unknown. Tokens for Google OAuth are stored here.

tables.description: Custom progress tracking widgets with targets and units
constraints: fk: user_id -> users.id ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.description: User-created kanban boards
constraints: fk: user_id -> users.id ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.description: Columns within kanban boards with ordering
constraints: fk: board_id -> kanban_boards.id ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.description: Tasks within kanban boards with priority and scheduling
constraints: fk: board_id -> kanban_boards.id ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.description: Photo/video album containers with smart album rules
constraints: fk: user_id -> users.id ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.description: Individual photos and videos with metadata, tags, and location
constraints: fk: user_id -> users.id ON DELETE CASCADE
tables.notes: Also used for inline images in text fields (missions, goals, daily logs). Images stored as base64 in file_data.

tables.description: NOVA AI chat conversation containers
constraints: fk: user_id -> users.id ON DELETE CASCADE
tables.notes: Soft delete via deleted_at. Supersedes legacy ai_messages table.

tables.description: Individual messages within NOVA AI conversations
constraints: fk: conversation_id -> conversations.id ON DELETE CASCADE
tables.notes: Role: 'user' or 'assistant'. Content is full message text.

tables.description: Tracks knowledge base items user has dismissed
Custom user-defined mission categories with AI descriptions
Hierarchical ritual groups for organizing ritualized missions
tables.notes: Hierarchical via parent_group_value (text reference, not FK).

tables.description: Dashboard widget collapse/expand states stored as JSONB
User activity event log for analytics and behavioral tracking
Configurable smart notification reminders per user
Notion-style custom mission views (board, list, calendar) with filters and columns
constraints: fk: user_id -> users.id ON DELETE CASCADE

tables.description: Firebase Cloud Messaging push notification tokens
Pre-launch waitlist email collection

security_concerns: integrations table stores OAuth tokens as plain text
No RLS policies on any table
user_profile contains highly sensitive personal data (shadow patterns, beliefs, trauma, financial data)
